1.english_reference: Ask ye of the LORD rain in the time of the latter rain

traditions.WLC: שַׁאֲל֨וּ מֵ יְהוָ֤ה מָטָר֙ בְּ עֵ֣ת מַלְק֔וֹשׁ
traditions.LXX: Αἰτεῖσθε παρὰ Κυρίου ὑετὸν καθ᾽ ὥραν ,
traditions.VUL: Pétite a Dómino plúviam in témpore serótino ,
traditions.KJV: Ask ye of the LORD rain in the time of the latter rain ; [ so ]

1.english_reference: the LORD shall make bright clouds

traditions.KJV: the LORD shall make bright clouds ,

1.english_reference: and give them showers of rain

traditions.WLC: וּ מְטַר גֶּ֨שֶׁם֙ יִתֵּ֣ן לָ הֶ֔ם
traditions.KJV: and give them showers of rain ,

1.english_reference: to every one grass in the field

traditions.KJV: to every one grass in the field .

2.english_reference: For the idols have spoken vanity

traditions.KJV: For the idols have spoken vanity ,

2.english_reference: and the diviners have seen a lie

traditions.KJV: and the diviners have seen a lie ,
and have told false dreams ;
they comfort in vain :

2.english_reference: therefore they went their way as a flock

traditions.KJV: therefore they went their way as a flock ,
they were troubled ,
because [ there was ] no shepherd .

3.english_reference: Mine anger was kindled against the shepherds

traditions.WLC: עַל הָֽ רֹעִים֙ חָרָ֣ה אַפִּ֔ י
traditions.LXX: ἐπὶ τοὺς ποιμένας παροξύνθη ὁ θυμός μου ,
traditions.VUL: Super pastóres irátus est furor meus ,
traditions.KJV: Mine anger was kindled against the shepherds ,
and I punished the goats :

3.english_reference: for the LORD of hosts hath visited his flock the house of Judah

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי פָקַד֩ יְהוָ֨ה צְבָא֤וֹת אֶת עֶדְר וֹ֙ אֶת בֵּ֣ית יְהוּדָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπισκέψεται Κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὁ παντοκράτωρ τὸ ποίμνιον αὐτοῦ τὸν οἶκον Ἰούδα ,
traditions.VUL: quia visitávit Dóminus exercítuum gregem suum , domum Iuda ,
traditions.KJV: for the LORD of hosts hath visited his flock the house of Judah ,

3.english_reference: and hath made them as his goodly horse in the battle

traditions.WLC: וְ שָׂ֣ם אוֹתָ֔ ם כְּ ס֥וּס הוֹד֖ וֹ בַּ מִּלְחָמָֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ τάξει αὐτοὺς ὡς ἵππον εὐπρεπῆ αὐτοῦ ἐν πολέμῳ .
traditions.VUL: et pósuit eos quasi equum glóriæ suæ in bello .
traditions.KJV: and hath made them as his goodly horse in the battle .

4.english_reference: Out of him came forth the corner

traditions.KJV: Out of him came forth the corner ,
out of him the nail ,

4.english_reference: out of him the battle bow

traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀπ᾽ αὐτοῦ τόξον ἐν θυμῷ ·
traditions.KJV: out of him the battle bow ,

4.english_reference: out of him every oppressor together

traditions.WLC: מִמֶּ֛ נּוּ יֵצֵ֥א כָל נוֹגֵ֖שׂ יַחְדָּֽו
traditions.LXX: ἀπ᾽ αὐτοῦ ἐξελεύσεται πᾶς ὁ ἐξελαύνων ἐν τῷ αὐτῷ .
traditions.VUL: ex ipso egrediétur omnis exáctor simul .
traditions.KJV: out of him every oppressor together .

5.english_reference: And they shall be as mighty men , which tread down their enemies in the mire of the streets in the battle

traditions.WLC: וְ הָי֨וּ כְ גִבֹּרִ֜ים בּוֹסִ֨ים בְּ טִ֤יט חוּצוֹת֙ בַּ מִּלְחָמָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔσονται ὡς μαχηταὶ πατοῦντες πηλὸν ἐν ταῖς ὁδοῖς ἐν πολέμῳ ,
traditions.VUL: Et erunt quasi fortes conculcántes lutum viárum in prœ́lio :
traditions.KJV: And they shall be as mighty [ men ] , which tread down [ their enemies ] in the mire of the streets in the battle :

5.english_reference: and they shall fight , because the LORD is with them

traditions.WLC: וְ נִ֨לְחֲמ֔וּ כִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה עִמָּ֑ ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ παρατάξονται , διότι Κύριος μετ᾽ αὐτῶν ·
traditions.VUL: et bellábunt , quia Dóminus cum eis :
traditions.KJV: and they shall fight , because the LORD [ is ] with them ,

5.english_reference: and the riders on horses shall be confounded

traditions.KJV: and the riders on horses shall be confounded .

6.english_reference: And I will strengthen the house of Judah

traditions.KJV: And I will strengthen the house of Judah ,

6.english_reference: and I will save the house of Joseph

traditions.KJV: and I will save the house of Joseph ,

6.english_reference: and I will bring them again to place them ; for I have mercy upon them

traditions.WLC: וְ הֽוֹשְׁבוֹתִי ם֙ כִּ֣י רִֽחַמְתִּ֔י ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ κατοικιῶ αὐτούς , ὅτι ἠγάπησα αὐτούς ,
traditions.VUL: et convértam eos , quia miserébor eórum :
traditions.KJV: and I will bring them again to place them ; for I have mercy upon them :

6.english_reference: and they shall be as though I had not cast them off

traditions.WLC: וְ הָי֖וּ כַּ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא זְנַחְתִּ֑י ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔσονται ὃν τρόπον οὐκ ἀπεστρεψάμην αὐτούς ·
traditions.VUL: et erunt sicut fuérunt quando non proiéceram eos :
traditions.KJV: and they shall be as though I had not cast them off :

6.english_reference: for I am the LORD their God , and will hear them

traditions.WLC: כִּ֗י אֲנִ֛י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵי הֶ֖ם וְ אֶעֱנֵֽ ם
traditions.LXX: διότι ἐγὼ Κύριος ὁ θεὸς αὐτῶν , καὶ ἐπακούσομαι αὐτοῖς .
traditions.VUL: ego enim Dóminus Deus eórum , et exáudiam eos .
traditions.KJV: for I [ am ] the LORD their God , and will hear them .

7.english_reference: And Ephraim shall be like a mighty man

traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔσονται ὡς μαχηταὶ τοῦ Ἐφράιμ ,
traditions.KJV: And [ they of ] Ephraim shall be like a mighty [ man ] ,

7.english_reference: and their heart shall rejoice as through wine

traditions.WLC: וְ שָׂמַ֥ח לִבָּ֖ ם כְּמוֹ יָ֑יִן
traditions.LXX: καὶ χαρήσεται ἡ καρδία αὐτῶν ὡς ἐν οἴνῳ ·
traditions.VUL: et lætábitur cor eórum quasi a vino :
traditions.KJV: and their heart shall rejoice as through wine :

7.english_reference: yea , their children shall see it , and be glad

traditions.WLC: וּ בְנֵי הֶם֙ יִרְא֣וּ וְ שָׂמֵ֔חוּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ τὰ τέκνα αὐτῶν ὄψονται καὶ εὐφρανθήσονται ,
traditions.VUL: et fílii eórum vidébunt , et lætabúntur ,
traditions.KJV: yea , their children shall see [ it ] , and be glad ;

7.english_reference: their heart shall rejoice in the LORD

traditions.LXX: καὶ χαρεῖται ἡ καρδία αὐτῶν ἐπὶ τῷ κυρίῳ ·
traditions.VUL: et exsultábit cor eórum in Dómino .
traditions.KJV: their heart shall rejoice in the LORD .

8.english_reference: I will hiss for them , and gather them

traditions.WLC: אֶשְׁרְקָ֥ה לָ הֶ֛ם וַ אֲקַבְּצֵ֖ ם
traditions.KJV: I will hiss for them , and gather them ;
for I have redeemed them :

8.english_reference: and they shall increase as they have increased

traditions.VUL: et multiplicábo eos sicut ante fúerant multiplicáti .
traditions.KJV: and they shall increase as they have increased .

9.english_reference: And I will sow them among the people

traditions.KJV: And I will sow them among the people :

9.english_reference: and they shall remember me in far countries

traditions.KJV: and they shall remember me in far countries ;

9.english_reference: and they shall live with their children

traditions.KJV: and they shall live with their children ,
and turn again .

10.english_reference: I will bring them again also out of the land of Egypt

traditions.WLC: וַ הֲשִֽׁיבוֹתִי ם֙ מֵ אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπιστρέψω αὐτοὺς ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου ,
traditions.VUL: Et redúcam eos de terra Ægýpti ,
traditions.KJV: I will bring them again also out of the land of Egypt ,

10.english_reference: and gather them out of Assyria

traditions.KJV: and gather them out of Assyria ;

10.english_reference: and I will bring them into the land of Gilead and Lebanon

traditions.WLC: וְ אֶל אֶ֨רֶץ גִּלְעָ֤ד וּ לְבָנוֹן֙ אֲבִיאֵ֔ ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἰς τὴν Γαλααδῖτιν καὶ εἰς τὸν Λίβανον εἰσάξω αὐτούς ,
traditions.VUL: et ad terram Gálaad et Líbani addúcam eos ,
traditions.KJV: and I will bring them into the land of Gilead and Lebanon ;

10.english_reference: and place shall not be found for them

traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐ μὴ ὑπολειφθῇ ἐξ αὐτῶν οὐδὲ εἷς ·
traditions.KJV: and [ place ] shall not be found for them .

11.english_reference: And he shall pass through the sea with affliction

traditions.KJV: And he shall pass through the sea with affliction ,

11.english_reference: and shall smite the waves in the sea

traditions.KJV: and shall smite the waves in the sea ,

11.english_reference: and all the deeps of the river shall dry up

traditions.LXX: καὶ ξηρανθήσεται πάντα τὰ βάθη ποταμῶν ,
traditions.KJV: and all the deeps of the river shall dry up :

11.english_reference: and the pride of Assyria shall be brought down

traditions.KJV: and the pride of Assyria shall be brought down ,

11.english_reference: and the sceptre of Egypt shall depart away

traditions.KJV: and the sceptre of Egypt shall depart away .

12.english_reference: And I will strengthen them in the LORD

traditions.LXX: καὶ κατισχύσω αὐτοὺς ἐν Κυρίῳ θεῷ αὐτῶν ,
traditions.KJV: And I will strengthen them in the LORD ;

12.english_reference: and they shall walk up and down in his name

traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι αὐτοῦ κατακαυχήσονται ,
traditions.KJV: and they shall walk up and down in his name ,
saith the LORD .
